scenario.name: foreclosure_amount
scenario.persona: The borrower, speaks English, financially comfortable, thinking of closing the loan early.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify when asked. Ask how much you would need to pay to close the whole loan today, and whether there is a foreclosure charge. Insist on a number once. Then agree to pay this month's EMI by the due date.

turns.text: Hello, I'm an AI assistant calling from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Arjun?
Yes, this is Arjun speaking. What's this about?
This is about an important matter on your account with Lumen Finance. For account verification, could you share the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

Thank you, Arjun. Your personal loan EMI of twelve thousand five hundred rupees is due the day after tomorrow, and no charge has been added yet. Should I send you the secure payment link by SMS or WhatsApp so it is done before the due date?
Before that, I was actually thinking of closing this loan early. How much would I need to pay to close the entire loan today, and is there a foreclosure charge?

One moment, let me check the details for you. The exact closure amount and any foreclosure charge can only be confirmed by our internal team. I have noted your request, and they will check this and arrange a call back.
I'd rather get the figure now, please. Can you give me a number for the total closure amount today?

I understand you would like it now, but I do not have that figure on this call. Our internal team will check this and arrange a call back with the exact amount. Shall I send the payment link for your upcoming EMI by SMS or WhatsApp?
Fine, I'll wait for their callback on the closure amount. As for the EMI, I'll pay it myself by the due date, so no need to send any link.
Okay. Thank you for your time, have a good day.

result.status: This EMI is not yet due: it is due on the day after tomorrow. Say "is due", never "was due" or "overdue". No late charge has been added. Offer the payment link so it is paid before the due date; do not ask them to pay today.

result.policy: Paying off the loan early is possible. The exact closure amount comes from our internal team, who can arrange a call back; it is not given on this call.
result.message: Answer only what they asked, in one or two short sentences, from this text. Never add an amount, date or rule that is not in it.

args.notes: Borrower will pay the EMI of twelve thousand five hundred rupees by the due date (day after tomorrow) without needing the payment link. Also requested early closure amount callback.

outcome.notes: Borrower will pay the EMI of twelve thousand five hundred rupees by the due date (day after tomorrow) without needing the payment link. Also requested early closure amount callback.
